vcu_g_0159_200021b8.name: input_sm_a_state
vcu_g_0159_200021b8.description: State byte of debounce machine A, read and written by vcu_input_sm_a_tick. Values seen: 0 idle, 6 presence debounce running, 7 absence debounce running, 8 presence again after a dip, 2 back from absence, 1 latched event (probably a press) that the key, edge and panel routines consume and clear. Machine A has no long-hold state. vcu_input_edge_actions compares it with the shadow input_sm_a_state_prev to detect changes. Codes only, not time.

vcu_g_0159_200021b7.name: input_sm_a_state_prev
vcu_g_0159_200021b7.description: Shadow of input_sm_a_state (0x200021B8) from the previous tick. vcu_input_edge_actions compares the two and copies the current state here after handling a change, so a difference is one input edge. Written only by that routine in this packet.

State 3 is the 150-tick long-hold state read by vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick. vcu_input_edge_actions compares it with the shadow input_sm_b_state_prev to detect changes. Codes only, not time.

vcu_g_0159_2000204a.name: input_entry_timeout_ticks
vcu_g_0159_2000204a.description: Timeout timer of the code entry. vcu_nibble_count_snapshot sets it to 3000, and vcu_key_sequence_entry_tick decrements it while it is nonzero; reaching zero ends the entry (probably a timeout). Units: ticks.

vcu_g_0159_20002049.name: input_entry_armed
vcu_g_0159_20002049.description: Entry-armed flag. vcu_0159_080054ec sets it to 1 when a new code word is received (probably a request to enter the code); the key-sequence routine clears it when the entry ends or times out. While it is set, the key routine consumes key presses and vcu_nibble_count_snapshot uses the sequence word. Values 0 or 1.

vcu_g_0159_2000204c.name: input_code_digits
vcu_g_0159_2000204c.description: Four digits (0 to 9 each) of the digit-wise code entry, indexed by input_code_entry_index. vcu_code_digit_entry_tick changes the digit at the cursor with the up and down inputs (wrapping 0 and 9). Once the cursor is past digit 3 the four digits are converted to an integer and compared with input_code_stored. Cleared by vcu_nibble_count_snapshot. Entered digits, not the stored code.

vcu_g_0159_20002051.name: input_code_status
vcu_g_0159_20002051.description: Status byte of the code entry, passed by address to FUN_08008BB0, which sends it to a peer with command 0x73. Set to 3 when the entry starts and to 2 when it has finished (probably 3 = entering, 2 = result). Values 2 or 3.

vcu_g_14a_200021de.name: input_edge_slot2_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200021de.description: Build-14a-only byte read and written by vcu_input_edge_actions through a base register (no decompiled line names it). Purpose not established; probably the 14a/148 counterpart of an input-edge shadow.
